title_zh: RailWeave v2.2 三项重点项目实施台账
title_en: RailWeave v2.2 Implementation Register for Three Priority Projects
boundary_zh: 本台账为开放共创形成的概念建议，不代表相关部门、场地权利人、企业、高校或专业机构已同意参与，不构成预算安排、采购决定、投资承诺、建设时序或政府审定结论。具体项目名称、实施主体、场地边界、资金来源、技术路线和验收标准，应在完成现场核验、需求确认、公众参与、专业论证并依法履行相关程序后确定。
boundary_en: This register is a conceptual recommendation developed through open co-creation. It does not indicate that any public authority, site rights holder, enterprise, university, or professional institution has agreed to participate, and it does not constitute an approved budget, procurement decision, investment commitment, construction schedule, or government determination. Project titles, implementing entities, site boundaries, funding sources, technical approaches, and acceptance criteria shall be determined only after site verification, demand confirmation, public participation, professional review, and all legally required procedures.

minimum_evidence_zh: 临时边界与待核验事项
场地权利和现状核验责任人
minimum_evidence_en: Responsible role for site-rights and baseline verification
stage_gates.no_go_zh: 证据来源、场地权利或安全前提不清时不得转段。
stage_gates.no_go_en: The project shall not advance where evidence provenance, site rights, or safety prerequisites remain unclear.

minimum_evidence_zh: 受影响用户和公众意见回应
stage_gates.no_go_zh: 需求所有者不明确、只能依赖不合规数据或无法保留必要人工服务时不得转段。
stage_gates.no_go_en: The project shall not advance where the demand owner is unclear, non-compliant data are indispensable, or necessary human service cannot be retained.

minimum_evidence_zh: 限定场地、期限和用户范围
版本、输入输出和人工接管记录
minimum_evidence_en: Bounded site, duration, and user scope
stage_gates.no_go_zh: 不得将展示性原型直接扩大为默认部署。
stage_gates.no_go_en: A demonstration prototype shall not be expanded directly into default deployment.

minimum_evidence_zh: 独立复核和利益冲突披露
通过、限用、整改或停止结论
minimum_evidence_en: Pass, restricted-use, corrective-action, or stop finding
stage_gates.no_go_zh: 重大安全问题、版本不明或未披露利益冲突未关闭时不得转段。
stage_gates.no_go_en: The project shall not advance while major safety issues, unidentified versions, or undisclosed conflicts remain unresolved.

minimum_evidence_zh: 依法确定的采购或合作文件
minimum_evidence_en: Lawfully determined procurement or cooperation documentation
stage_gates.no_go_zh: 测试结果不得替代采购决定，不得预设供应商、合同或成交结果。
stage_gates.no_go_en: Test results shall not replace a procurement decision, and no supplier, contract, or award outcome shall be predetermined.

minimum_evidence_zh: 公共利益、风险和财务复核
stage_gates.no_go_zh: 持续使用、维护、人工接管或风险条件不满足时应整改、限用或恢复原业务流程。
stage_gates.no_go_en: Where sustained use, maintenance, human takeover, or risk conditions are not met, the project should be corrected, restricted, or returned to the original service process.

minimum_evidence_zh: 数据、合同、设备、场地与替代服务处置
minimum_evidence_en: Disposition of data, contracts, equipment, site, and alternative service
stage_gates.no_go_zh: 退出事项未关闭时项目台账不得归档为完成。
stage_gates.no_go_en: The register shall not be closed as complete while exit actions remain outstanding.

roles.appointment_boundary_en: The specific organisation remains subject to lawful determination

roles.title_zh: 依法确定的实施主体或场地权利人
roles.title_en: Legally Determined Implementing Entity or Site Rights Holder
roles.appointment_boundary_en: Subject to rights and authority verification

roles.title_zh: 需求单位或应用责任单位
roles.appointment_boundary_zh: 须对真实需求和非AI基线负责
roles.appointment_boundary_en: Must be accountable for the real demand and non-AI baseline

roles.appointment_boundary_zh: 通过协议或依法采购确定
roles.appointment_boundary_en: To be appointed through agreement or lawful procurement

roles.appointment_boundary_zh: 应披露利益冲突并保持结论独立
roles.appointment_boundary_en: Must disclose conflicts and preserve independence of findings

roles.title_zh: 数据控制、隐私和网络安全责任角色
roles.title_en: Data Control, Privacy, and Cybersecurity Role
roles.appointment_boundary_zh: 具体法定身份和职责待核验
roles.appointment_boundary_en: The specific legal status and duties remain subject to verification

roles.title_zh: 采购、财务、法务和审计角色
roles.title_en: Procurement, Finance, Legal, and Audit Role
roles.appointment_boundary_zh: 不得由技术方案预设采购结论
roles.appointment_boundary_en: The technical proposal shall not predetermine procurement outcomes

roles.appointment_boundary_zh: 代表性与参与方式待项目章程确定
roles.appointment_boundary_en: Representation and participation method remain subject to the project charter

raci_legend.rule_zh: 原则上每项工作只设一个A；具体组织应通过法定程序、协议、采购文件和项目章程确定。
raci_legend.rule_en: Each activity should normally have one accountable role; organisations shall be appointed through lawful procedures, agreements, procurement documents, and project charters.

raci_matrix.activity_zh: 数据影响和网络安全评估

project_registers.title_en: Beijing AI Origin Community Demand Coordination Room
project_registers.objective_zh: 建立居民、高校、企业、公共服务单位和一线运营人员共同提出、澄清、排序和复核AI城市需求的常态化入口，避免由技术供应方单方面定义需求。
project_registers.objective_en: Establish a standing channel through which residents, universities, enterprises, public-service bodies, and frontline operators can jointly identify, clarify, prioritise, and review urban AI needs, avoiding supplier-led problem definition.
project_registers.spatial_guidance_zh: 优先研究利用既有室内公共服务、园区共享或社区议事空间，采用可逆、可移动、无障碍布置；具体场地、面积和改造条件待核验。
project_registers.spatial_guidance_en: Prioritise the study of existing public-service, shared campus, or community meeting space with reversible, movable, and accessible components; the site, floor area, and alteration conditions remain subject to verification.
primary_users_zh: 需要无障碍支持的群体
project_registers.data_boundary_zh: 默认不采集人脸、声纹、精确轨迹等生物识别或持续监控数据；个人信息处理须另行明确目的、最小范围、保存期限、撤回和删除机制。
project_registers.data_boundary_en: Facial, voiceprint, precise movement, and other biometric or continuous-monitoring data should not be collected by default; any personal-data processing requires a defined purpose, minimum scope, retention period, withdrawal, and deletion process.
project_registers.procurement_guidance_zh: 可依法采购需求调研、公众参与组织、服务设计和原型支持；不得将需求协同服务采购等同于最终AI产品采购，不得预设技术供应商。
project_registers.procurement_guidance_en: Demand research, public participation, service design, and prototype support may be lawfully procured; procurement of coordination services shall not be treated as procurement of the final AI product, and no supplier shall be preselected.
project_registers.funding_character_zh: 公益性基础服务为主，可研究依法纳入相关公共服务、城市更新研究或运营主体年度预算；具体来源以预算和采购程序为准。
project_registers.funding_character_en: Primarily a public-interest foundational service; possible inclusion in public-service, urban-renewal research, or operator budgets may be studied subject to lawful budget and procurement procedures.
acceptance_artifacts_zh: 进入或不进入PoC的书面理由
acceptance_artifacts_en: Written grounds for admitting or rejecting a PoC
pause_conditions_zh: 只能依赖非公开或不合规数据
无法保留必要人工服务
公共利益风险明显高于预期收益
pause_conditions_en: Unavoidable reliance on non-public or non-compliant data
Inability to retain necessary human service
Public-interest risk materially exceeding anticipated benefit
project_registers.exit_zh: 关闭相关数字入口，完成个人信息删除或匿名化，归档可公开成果，恢复场地原状，并说明停止原因和替代服务。
project_registers.exit_en: Close relevant digital channels, delete or anonymise personal data, archive publishable outputs, restore the site, and state the reason for termination and the alternative service.

project_registers.title_zh: 众智园独立测试验证实验室
project_registers.title_en: Zhongzhiyuan Independent Testing and Validation Laboratory
project_registers.objective_zh: 对拟进入城市空间、产业服务和公共服务场景的AI模型、边缘设备及工作流开展可复现、安全、隐私、公平、无障碍、能耗和人工接管测试。
project_registers.objective_en: Conduct reproducible testing of AI models, edge devices, and workflows proposed for urban, industrial, and public-service settings, covering safety, privacy, fairness, accessibility, energy use, and human takeover.
project_registers.spatial_guidance_zh: 优先研究利用既有研发或测试空间，设置受控测试区、人工复核区、结果说明区和隔离存储区；具体载体、设备条件和资质要求待专业核验。
project_registers.spatial_guidance_en: Study the reuse of existing R&D or testing premises, with controlled testing, human review, results interpretation, and isolated storage zones; premises, equipment conditions, and qualification requirements remain subject to professional verification.
outputs_zh: 通过、限用、整改或停止结论
outputs_en: Pass, restricted-use, corrective-action, or stop finding
project_registers.independence_zh: 测试结论不得由被测产品供应商单方出具；测试、采购和商业转化角色原则上相互分离，利益冲突应披露。
project_registers.independence_en: Findings shall not be issued solely by the supplier of the tested product. Testing, procurement, and commercial-conversion roles should in principle remain separate, with conflicts disclosed.
project_registers.data_boundary_zh: 优先使用合成、匿名化或获得合法授权的数据；生产数据不得因测试便利而默认进入实验环境。
project_registers.data_boundary_en: Synthetic, anonymised, or lawfully authorised data should be prioritised; production data shall not enter the test environment by default.
project_registers.procurement_guidance_zh: 可依法分别采购测试环境、工具、专业验证和安全服务；独立验证结果不替代采购、审批、认证或法定责任判断。
project_registers.procurement_guidance_en: Test environments, tools, specialist validation, and security services may be procured separately. Independent validation does not replace procurement, approval, certification, or statutory responsibility.
project_registers.funding_character_zh: 公共测试底座与具体项目验证费用分类核算；可研究基础能力共担、项目服务付费和科研试点支持，均以依法确定结果为准。
project_registers.funding_character_en: Shared testing infrastructure and project-specific validation costs should be separately accounted for; shared base funding, service fees, and research support may be studied subject to lawful determination.
pause_conditions_zh: 训练或测试数据来源不清
高风险场景缺人工接管
测试机构存在未披露利益冲突
pause_conditions_en: No human takeover for a high-risk scenario
project_registers.exit_zh: 隔离或销毁受限数据，撤销测试访问权限，归档可公开报告，按协议返还设备，保留事故和整改记录。
project_registers.exit_en: Isolate or destroy restricted data, revoke test access, archive publishable reports, return equipment under applicable agreements, and retain incident and corrective-action records.

project_registers.title_zh: 大钟寺首用转化与运营池
project_registers.title_en: Dazhongsi First-Use Conversion and Operations Pool
project_registers.naming_boundary_zh: 运营池指项目、需求、服务和后评估的协同台账，不构成投资基金、金融产品、融资担保或财政资金池。
project_registers.naming_boundary_en: The Operations Pool means a coordinated register of projects, demands, services, and post-deployment evaluations. It is not an investment fund, financial product, financing guarantee, or fiscal funding pool.
project_registers.objective_zh: 将通过验证且确有真实需求的方案转入市场调研、依法采购、受控上线和90/180日后评估，减少只展示、不使用。
project_registers.objective_en: Move validated solutions with confirmed demand into market research, lawful procurement, controlled deployment, and 90/180-day evaluation, reducing demonstration-only projects.
project_registers.spatial_guidance_zh: 设置面向需求发布、产品比较、合规咨询、演示和运行评价的复合界面；具体场地、商业面积、连通方式和建筑条件待核验。
project_registers.spatial_guidance_en: Provide a combined interface for demand publication, product comparison, compliance advice, demonstrations, and operational evaluation; the site, commercial floor area, connections, and building conditions remain subject to verification.
project_registers.data_boundary_zh: 运营监测以完成服务和安全管理所必需的数据为限，不得以展示、营销或转化为由扩大个人信息收集。
project_registers.data_boundary_en: Operational monitoring shall be limited to data necessary for service delivery and safety; personal-data collection shall not be expanded for demonstration, marketing, or conversion.
project_registers.procurement_guidance_zh: 成熟产品可依法采用适用采购方式；原型测试结果仅为技术证据之一；实质性创新需求可研究适当机制，但不得预设采购方式、供应商和成交结果。
project_registers.procurement_guidance_en: Mature products may follow an applicable lawful procurement route. Prototype results are only one item of technical evidence. A suitable mechanism may be studied for substantively innovative needs, without preselecting the method, supplier, or award outcome.
project_registers.funding_character_zh: 公益性服务、项目验证和市场化应用分别核算；市场化项目不得以不确定收入抵扣已发生的公共责任成本。
project_registers.funding_character_en: Public-interest services, validation, and market applications should be separately accounted for. Uncertain commercial income shall not offset public obligations already incurred.
pause_conditions_zh: 全生命周期成本不可承受
只能依赖排他性或不透明技术条件
pause_conditions_en: Implementation depends on exclusive or opaque technical conditions
project_registers.exit_zh: 完成合同和数据退出、系统下线、替代服务恢复、设备及场地处置和未结事项清理，并将可公开经验纳入知识库。
project_registers.exit_en: Complete contractual and data exit, system shutdown, restoration of alternative service, equipment and site disposition, and closure of outstanding matters; archive publishable lessons.

five_year_cost_model.estimate_boundary_zh: 现阶段不具备经核验的场地面积、设备清单、并发能力、人员配置、采购价格和法定责任条件，不提出人民币总投资结论。
five_year_cost_model.estimate_boundary_en: Verified site area, equipment lists, concurrent capacity, staffing, procurement prices, and statutory responsibilities are not yet available; no fixed monetary investment conclusion is proposed.

scenarios.zh: 最大限度复用既有空间、设备和人员，仅运行最低可行原型。
scenarios.en: Maximum reuse of existing premises, equipment, and personnel; minimum viable prototypes only.

scenarios.zh: 配置相对独立的服务空间、核心设备和稳定运营团队，支持适度并行项目。
scenarios.en: Relatively dedicated service space, core equipment, and a stable operations team supporting moderate concurrency.

scenarios.zh: 增加专用设备、高等级安全条件、较高并行能力和更完整的公众开放服务。
scenarios.en: Additional dedicated equipment, higher security conditions, greater concurrency, and more complete public-facing services.

five_year_cost_model.formula: TC5 = C0 + sum_year_1_to_5(Ot + Mt + Pt + Vt + At + Rt) + U + X

variables.zh: 初始建设与配置成本，不含未经核验的土地和新建工程价值
variables.en: Initial fit-out and configuration, excluding unverified land value and new construction

variables.zh: 年度人员、项目管理和运营
variables.en: Annual staffing, project management, and operations

variables.zh: 独立验证、法务、审计和数据安全
variables.en: Independent validation, legal, audit, and data security

variables.zh: 公众参与、无障碍和公共传播
variables.en: Public participation, accessibility, and public communication

variables.zh: 第三至第四年设备和工具更新情景
variables.en: Equipment and tool renewal scenario in Years 3–4

variables.zh: 退出、数据清理和场地恢复
variables.en: Exit, data clearance, and site restoration

conceptual_control_bands.category_zh: 直接技术、设备和场地服务
conceptual_control_bands.category_en: Direct technology, equipment, and premises services

conceptual_control_bands.category_zh: 独立验证、法务、审计和数据安全
conceptual_control_bands.category_en: Independent validation, legal, audit, and data security

conceptual_control_bands.category_zh: 公众参与、无障碍和公共传播
保险、应急、退出和不可预见事项

five_year_cost_model.control_band_note_zh: 比例允许交叉，不得直接相加作为报价；金额应在服务能力和场地确认后，通过市场调查及依法开展的预算程序确定。
five_year_cost_model.control_band_note_en: The bands may overlap and shall not be added directly as a quotation. Amounts should be established only after service capacity and premises are confirmed through market research and lawful budgeting.
five_year_cost_model.recognition_boundary_zh: 意向函、预测订单、访问量、品牌曝光和未经签约的服务需求不得计入已确认资金；预算批复、合同生效或资金实际到位前不得表述为已落实。
five_year_cost_model.recognition_boundary_en: Letters of intent, forecast orders, visitor numbers, brand exposure, and unsigned demand shall not be recognised as confirmed funding; no source shall be described as secured before budget approval, contract effectiveness, or receipt of funds.

public_participation_loop.action_zh: 发布问题、证据状态、已知限制和非AI替代方案。
public_participation_loop.action_en: Disclose the problem, evidence status, limitations, and non-AI alternative.
public_participation_loop.artifact_zh: 可访问的议题说明和来源清单
public_participation_loop.artifact_en: Accessible issue note and source list
public_participation_loop.gate_zh: 公众能够理解正在研究和尚未确定的事项。
public_participation_loop.gate_en: The public can understand what is being studied and what remains undecided.

public_participation_loop.action_zh: 覆盖主要用户及需要特别保障的群体，提供线下、纸质和人工协助。
public_participation_loop.action_en: Include principal users and groups requiring additional protection, with offline, paper, and staffed channels.
public_participation_loop.artifact_zh: 招募方法、群体覆盖和利益冲突记录
public_participation_loop.artifact_en: Recruitment method, coverage, and conflict record
public_participation_loop.gate_zh: 不得以仅使用数字工具的人群代表全部公众。
public_participation_loop.gate_en: Digital-only participants shall not be treated as representing the whole public.

public_participation_loop.action_zh: 核对真实需求、影响群体、成功标准和停止条件。
public_participation_loop.action_en: Confirm actual need, affected groups, success criteria, and stop conditions.
public_participation_loop.artifact_zh: 需求简报、分歧记录和非AI基线
public_participation_loop.artifact_en: Demand brief, disagreement record, and non-AI baseline
public_participation_loop.gate_zh: 需求所有者和受影响群体明确。
public_participation_loop.gate_en: The demand owner and affected groups are identifiable.

public_participation_loop.action_zh: 说明数据目的、范围、保存、撤回、人工复核和申诉。
public_participation_loop.action_en: Explain purpose, scope, retention, withdrawal, human review, and appeal.
public_participation_loop.artifact_zh: 数据影响说明、合法处理依据和退出路径
public_participation_loop.artifact_en: Data-impact note, lawful basis, and exit route
public_participation_loop.gate_zh: 高风险和个人信息问题得到明确处置。
public_participation_loop.gate_en: High-risk and personal-data issues are explicitly addressed.

public_participation_loop.action_zh: 在限定空间、时间和用户范围内观察原型。
public_participation_loop.action_en: Observe a prototype within limited space, duration, and user scope.
public_participation_loop.artifact_zh: 测试日志、事件记录和无障碍观察
public_participation_loop.artifact_en: Test log, incident record, and accessibility observation
public_participation_loop.gate_zh: 展示不得直接扩大为默认部署。
public_participation_loop.gate_en: A demonstration shall not be expanded directly into default deployment.

public_participation_loop.action_zh: 发布脱敏结果，收集支持、反对和修改意见。
public_participation_loop.action_en: Publish redacted results and collect support, objections, and proposed changes.
public_participation_loop.artifact_zh: 评价摘要和逐项意见回应表
public_participation_loop.gate_zh: 重大异议完成复核，未解决问题保持公开可见。
public_participation_loop.gate_en: Major objections are reviewed and unresolved matters remain visible.

public_participation_loop.action_zh: 作出续期、整改、暂停或退出建议。
public_participation_loop.action_en: Recommend renewal, correction, pause, or exit.
public_participation_loop.artifact_zh: 决定理由、责任人、时限和90/180日追踪
public_participation_loop.artifact_en: Reasons, accountable role, timetable, and 90/180-day follow-up
public_participation_loop.gate_zh: 结论可追溯，投诉和复核渠道继续有效。
public_participation_loop.gate_en: The decision is traceable and complaint and review channels remain open.

participation_safeguards_zh: 线上、线下、纸质、电话和人工协助渠道并行
提供无障碍场地、易读版本和必要语言支持
参与不得替代个人信息同意、场地权利同意或法定审批
简单多数不得替代对弱势群体、公共安全和基本权利的审查
对重大风险保留暂停建议、独立复核和申诉渠道
participation_safeguards_en: Parallel online, offline, paper, telephone, and staffed channels
Accessible premises, easy-read materials, and appropriate language support
Participation does not replace personal-data consent, site-rights consent, or statutory approval
Simple majority does not replace review of vulnerable groups, public safety, and fundamental rights
Pause recommendation, independent review, and appeal channels for major risks
kpi_boundary_zh: 下列数值为启动控制值建议，不是政府承诺或正式绩效目标。项目启动后应依据基线调查调整，并经依法确定的责任主体确认。
kpi_boundary_en: The figures below are proposed starting control values, not government commitments or approved performance targets. They should be adjusted after baseline collection and confirmed by the lawfully determined responsible entities.

kpi_matrix.correction_zh: 退回补充，不进入PoC。
kpi_matrix.correction_en: Return incomplete cases; no PoC admission.

kpi_matrix.baseline_zh: 首季度按准入规则统计
kpi_matrix.correction_zh: 调整招募、模板和辅导，优先保证质量。
kpi_matrix.correction_en: Revise recruitment, templates, and guidance, prioritising quality.

kpi_matrix.proposed_target: 每个重大项目不少于5类主要用户，未覆盖须说明原因 / at least 5 principal groups per major project, with reasons for gaps
kpi_matrix.correction_zh: 定向补充招募并延长咨询。
kpi_matrix.correction_en: Conduct targeted recruitment and extend consultation.

kpi_matrix.proposed_target: >=90%; 重大异议100%说明状态 / status stated for 100% of major objections
kpi_matrix.correction_zh: 补充回应，必要时暂停转段。
kpi_matrix.correction_en: Complete responses and pause the gate if necessary.

kpi_matrix.proposed_target: 基本公共服务场景100% / 100% for essential public-service scenarios
kpi_matrix.correction_zh: 暂停上线并恢复替代服务。
kpi_matrix.correction_en: Pause deployment and restore the alternative service.

kpi_matrix.correction_zh: 固定版本、补充测试、降级或停止。
kpi_matrix.correction_en: Freeze versions, retest, restrict, or stop.

kpi_matrix.correction_zh: 补齐来源、版本和限制。
kpi_matrix.correction_en: Complete sources, versions, and limitations.

kpi_matrix.name_zh: 高风险场景人工接管覆盖
kpi_matrix.correction_zh: 不予上线或立即限用。
kpi_matrix.correction_en: Do not launch or restrict immediately.

kpi_matrix.correction_zh: 停止、通报、修复并独立复核。
kpi_matrix.correction_en: Stop, notify, remediate, and independently review.

kpi_matrix.proposed_target: 公开时限内100%完成或说明合法例外 / 100% within the disclosed period or documented lawful exception
kpi_matrix.correction_zh: 暂停相关处理活动并清理积压。
kpi_matrix.correction_en: Pause relevant processing and clear the backlog.

kpi_matrix.baseline_en: Establish a real baseline in Year 1
kpi_matrix.proposed_target: 30-50%，不得倒逼高风险项目上线 / 30-50%, without pressuring high-risk deployment
kpi_matrix.correction_zh: 分析需求、成本和采购障碍。
kpi_matrix.correction_en: Analyse demand, cost, and procurement barriers.

kpi_matrix.correction_zh: 开展用户研究、流程调整或停止。
kpi_matrix.correction_en: Conduct user research, redesign the process, or stop.

kpi_matrix.correction_zh: 评估续期、替代或退出。
kpi_matrix.correction_en: Evaluate renewal, replacement, or exit.

kpi_matrix.name_zh: 无障碍关键阻断关闭率
kpi_matrix.proposed_target: 重大阻断上线前100%关闭 / 100% of critical barriers closed before launch
kpi_matrix.correction_zh: 延迟上线或提供等效服务。
kpi_matrix.correction_en: Delay launch or provide equivalent service.

kpi_matrix.proposed_target: 按风险和服务等级依法确定 / to be determined by risk and service level
kpi_matrix.correction_zh: 扩容、安全降级或增加人工服务。
kpi_matrix.correction_en: Add capacity, degrade safely, or increase staffed service.

kpi_matrix.proposed_target: 按风险分级并至少年度演练 / tiered by risk with at least annual exercise
kpi_matrix.correction_zh: 修订预案、培训和资源配置。
kpi_matrix.correction_en: Revise plans, training, and resources.

kpi_matrix.proposed_target: 等质量下逐年下降或不高于经确认基准 / declining or no higher than confirmed baseline at equal quality
kpi_matrix.correction_zh: 优化模型、边缘部署或使用时段。
kpi_matrix.correction_en: Optimise the model, edge deployment, or operating window.

kpi_matrix.baseline_zh: 首季度排班和开放记录
kpi_matrix.proposed_target: 依据需求和预算设年度下限 / annual minimum based on demand and budget
kpi_matrix.correction_zh: 调整排班和资金分类。
kpi_matrix.correction_en: Adjust the schedule and funding classification.

kpi_matrix.proposed_target: 第三至第五年研究40-70%；公益部分不强制自平衡 / study 40-70% in Years 3-5; no self-financing requirement for public-interest services
kpi_matrix.correction_zh: 调价、降本或调整服务组合。
kpi_matrix.correction_en: Reprice, reduce cost, or adjust the service mix.

kpi_matrix.correction_zh: 台账不得关闭，持续完成数据、合同、设备、场地和替代服务处置。
kpi_matrix.correction_en: Keep the register open until data, contracts, equipment, site, and alternative service are fully addressed.
